audit.task: Build airlock-v2 persistent infrastructure (hooks + auto-commit daemon + 8hr cleanup daemon)

context.container_policy: /Users/kooshapari/CodeProjects/Phenotype/repos is a container, NOT a git working tree
context.philosophy: Conservative in refusal to delete without remote-backed state; aggressive in saving every agent action.

hooks.purpose: Shell script that reads event JSON from stdin, identifies cwd, commits wip branch if dirty
features: reads stdin event JSON (jq preferred, python3 fallback, $PWD last resort)
canonicalizes paths via python3 os.path.realpath (handles macOS /var -> /private/var symlink)
skips repos outside AIRLOCK_V2_ROOT
idempotent — re-running on clean tree is no-op
creates wip/<date>-<agent>-<event_id> branch
best-effort push to upstream; never force-pushes
best-effort notify to legacy airlock daemon socket (non-blocking 2s timeout)
30s timeout safe (intended to run from launchd wrapper)

daemons.purpose: 15-minute auto-commit daemon that walks repos/ for dirty working trees
features: fcntl lockfile for re-entrancy
graceful shutdown on SIGTERM / SIGINT
structured JSON logging to ~/.airlock-v2/logs/auto-commit.log
probes legacy airlock daemon socket (~/.airlock/socket) and skips sweep if busy
honors AIRLOCK_V2_AIRLOCK_SOCKET override (used by smoke test)
creates wip/<date>-<auto> branch per sweep
pushes to upstream; falls back to local-only if no upstream
per-repo 45s timeout; never blocks the loop
configurable AIRLOCK_V2_INTERVAL (default 900 = 15min)
DRY_RUN mode for safe smoke-testing
--once mode for single-pass smoke-testing

daemons.loaded_reason: user policy: human inspection required before launchctl load

daemons.purpose: 8-hour cleanup daemon that consolidates wip/* branches and archives stale airlock entries
features: fcntl lockfile for re-entrancy
graceful shutdown on SIGTERM / SIGINT
structured JSON logging to ~/.airlock-v2/logs/cleanup.log
walks all wip/* branches across all repos
consolidates each repo's wip/* cluster into wip/<date>-consolidated (squash merge)
pushes consolidated branch to upstream
deletes original wip/* branches LOCALLY only after remote-confirmed backup
archives ~/.airlock/repos/<id>/ older than 30 days to tar.zst with sha256 sidecar
NEVER deletes the original airlock entry — leaves it intact for human review
DRY_RUN mode for safe smoke-testing
configurable AIRLOCK_V2_STALE_DAYS / AIRLOCK_V2_ARCHIVE_DAYS (default 30)

daemons.loaded_reason: user policy: human inspection required before launchctl load

coverage: preflight (airlock-v2 dir, REPO_ROOT, python3, git, bash)
smoke repo creation (git init + initial commit + dirty state)
auto-commit daemon --once against isolated temp scan root
hook script invocation with synthetic Codex event
smoke_test.exit_codes: 0 = pass, 1 = setup fail, 2 = assertion fail, 3 = cleanup warning

docs.purpose: Architecture overview, design philosophy, operational characteristics

user_must_run_install_steps: copy plists to ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ and `launchctl load` them
(legacy airlock daemon may be left running untouched)

next_steps_for_user: Inspect the two .plist files before `launchctl load`-ing them
After install, monitor ~/.airlock-v2/logs/*.log for daemon activity
If smoke test is rerun during dev, expect rc=0 and the same wip/* branches to keep accumulating
